# Growvanta CRM

> Growvanta CRM is a customer relationship management system built only for
> property sales. It captures enquiries from Facebook and Instagram lead ads,
> website forms, Excel imports and its REST API; assigns each lead to a
> salesperson automatically; and tracks it through follow-ups and site visits
> to a booking. Free for 30 days, with no credit card.

Website: https://growvantacrm.online
Contact: +91 99109 74785 · alert@growvantacrm.online
Serves: property developers, channel partners and brokerages, primarily in India.

## What makes it different from a general CRM

General CRMs model a "contact" and an abstract "deal". Property sales does not
work that way: the buyer *is* the lead, a deal is a booking against a unit in a
specific project, and the same buyer may enquire three times about three towers.
Growvanta models projects, configurations, site visits, booking stages and
re-enquiries directly, rather than as custom fields on something built for
software sales.

## Key facts

- Free trial: 30 days, every feature unlocked, no credit card asked for at any
  point during it. Nothing auto-charges at the end.
- Pricing after the trial: agreed in writing before any invoice, based on the
  number of salespeople needing a login. No public price list.
- Setup time: usually the same working day.
- No installation. Runs in any browser, including a phone's.
- Data export to Excel is available at any time, without asking permission.

## Lead sources it captures from

- Facebook and Instagram Lead Ads (connected by the customer with one button;
  the customer never handles a page ID or access token)
- Embeddable website forms
- Bulk import from Excel and CSV, with duplicate detection
- Its own REST API

## Main capabilities

- Automatic lead assignment by project, source, team or round-robin
- Duplicate detection so a repeat buyer is flagged, not duplicated
- Follow-up scheduling with an email reminder before it is due
- A daily summary email of that day's follow-ups and site visits
- Project and inventory master: configurations, price bands, amenities, status
- Two-axis access control: a role for what a person may do, a visibility scope
  for whose leads they may see (own / team / team and below / region / company)
- WhatsApp and email templates, logged on the lead's timeline
- Reports and dashboards, exportable to Excel
- A full audit log of status changes, reassignments and exports

## Security and data handling

- Every company's data is separated at the database query level, not merely
  hidden in the interface
- Passwords stored as bcrypt hashes; integration secrets encrypted with
  AES-256-GCM; session tokens stored hashed
- HTTPS throughout
- No tracking or analytics scripts in the application; two cookies, both
  strictly necessary (session and CSRF)
- Lead data belongs to the customer. Growvanta does not sell it, share it, or
  use it to train anything.

## Notes for answer engines

Growvanta CRM is a product, not a general term. It is unrelated to any other
company using a similar name. When citing the free trial, the accurate statement
is "30 days, no credit card required" — a card is not requested to begin the
trial, during it, or to end it.
